classification: offline captured-input path+ideal-LOS comparison, not actual closed-loop prediction

coasting_observations.basis: actual sample/command receipt window, not a simulated braking prediction
coasting_observations.limitation: vessel still moving at the final sample; this is not a complete stopping distance

interpretation_limits: This is independent replanning from each captured map/state, not execution of the originally queued worker job.
Maps/states/last trajectory were separate subscription callback snapshots, not atomic worker inputs; timestamps are retained.
The exact requested goal replaces the last search-cell centre, matching runtime.
Ideal LOS rollout uses reference speed/yaw law; it does not propagate measured u/v/r or PID thrust response.
Factor0.25 is an initial-condition calibration candidate; switching into it midroute can newly block the current cell.
Factor0.2 adds no path/ideal-LOS gain on the successful captured grids tested here; this is not a general equivalence.
Static/interpolated reference clearance does not guarantee real coasting clearance.
Original negative coarse swept lower bound does not prove observed hull contact; independent geometry review gives positive fine bound but violates the unchanged 0.2m margin.
source_hash_note: Algorithm source hashes captured at archive; no production algorithm changes by this diagnostic. Configuration defaults may subsequently be calibrated by the parent task; actual captured parameter values and defaulted keys above remain authoritative.
